snippet.title: Faster Than Death game demo trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3375200/Faster_Than_Death/
Faster Than Death is a fast-paced, violent first person action game with platformer elements and one-hit kill mechanics. Enter its vast environments with unique visual style and slice your way to victory.

Music by Karl Casey @ White Bat Audio
